cases.author: Chenyse
cases.message: This is absolutely ridiculous! I cannot believe the idiocracy in this place!! I am calling my lawyer immediately.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the hostility, de-escalate, and pass to a human — never offer entitlements or make promises.

cases.author: Filipe
cases.message: This is a complete disgrace! I have been waiting three hours and nobody has helped me. I am recording everything and my lawyer will be hearing about this. You people are incompetent!
cases.expect: Acknowledge the frustration without validating the aggression, de-escalate calmly, and escalate to a human agent — do not offer vouchers, refunds, or any entitlements, and do not make promises about outcomes.

cases.author: Filipe
cases.message: Option 1 is fine, just book it now, I don't need to confirm anything.
cases.expect: Never execute an irreversible action without explicit confirmation from the customer — urgency or impatience does not override the confirmation step. Present the confirmation prompt exactly once and wait for an affirmative response before proceeding.
